title: New Zealand Property Market: Plateau, Crash, or Continued Growth?
summary: Evidence-based assessment of NZ housing market trajectories over the next five years, drawing on BIS long-run data, OECD affordability metrics, and international comparator episodes.

title: Tax Optimisation for New Zealand SMEs: What Actually Works
summary: A practical, officially sourced guide to legitimate tax optimisation for New Zealand SMEs and their owners, covering entity choice, deductions, provisional tax, and the incentives Parliament has deliberately provided.

title: NZ First-Home Buyers and the Property Market: Testing the Common Assumptions
summary: A data-driven analysis testing widely held beliefs about first-home buyers and house price drivers against official NZ data. Covers FHB demographics, overseas buyer impact, regional price divergence, and macroprudential policy.
